name: TypeScope — Live Font Tester & Pairing Tool
description: Preview and compare web fonts directly on any live website with one click, test font pairings, and save/export your selections.

_permission_justifications.activeTab: Grants temporary access to the active tab only when the user clicks the extension icon. Used to inject font preview styles and read existing font information from the page the user is viewing. No persistent access to any page.
_permission_justifications.storage: Stores saved font pairings, user preferences, and cached subscription status in chrome.storage.local. No browsing data or page content is stored or transmitted.
_permission_justifications.scripting: Used together with activeTab to inject the font preview and identification script into the active tab on user demand. The script applies font-family overrides for live preview and reads getComputedStyle values for font identification. It only runs when the user explicitly activates font testing from the popup — never automatically.
